title: ze_ffvii_malgo_reactor_v6_b18
description: A CS:GO map (Source 1, baked from its BSP): the two endings of Insane II. Hellz: Bahamut's Fulgor, then Sephiroth and his lasers in the reactor's lower corridor. Cosmo: Bahamut, then Genesis on the walkway to the airship.

scenarios.name: Hellz ending (full)
scenarios.summary: Bahamut, Sephiroth, then out through the bunker
scenarios.description: Extreme III (Hellz) from 'Hellz once 6' (its touch replayed, fastForward 44 s: the Sephiroth and Bahamut templates spawn at 35.1 s, '[dnb] - muzzy - endgameb' at 42 s). At 45 s Final_Fulgor_Relay starts Bahamut's Fulgor: Sephiroth_Final_HP_Counter adds 460 HP per human to Hellz_Final_Fulgor_Breakable (1000). Its OnBreak gives Sephiroth 250 + 101 per human and starts Rainbow_LaserTimer 3 s later. Bridge_Door_Bunker opens when Sephiroth breaks, or 67 s after the touch anyway (speed 18). LevelHellz_Trig_ct behind it enables 'Nuke win' 5.1 s later (the once's own nuke comes at 90 s): win by being alive past the door when it goes off.

scenarios.name: Sephiroth (final boss)
scenarios.summary: Shoot Sephiroth through the rainbow lasers
scenarios.description: From the moment Bahamut falls: the stage breaks Hellz_Final_Fulgor_Breakable and its own OnBreak runs the fight. Sephiroth_Final_Breakable is set to 250 HP, Sephiroth_Final_HP_Counter is enabled for 0.04 s (AddHealth 101 per human touching it: the corridor is inside it), Sephiroth says 'Too late for laments' and Rainbow_LaserTimer starts 3 s later (0.9-1.3 s refire: Rainbow_LaserCase picks one of the s_laser_1..4 templates; each laser that hurts a human takes 25 HP off him). Win when his OnBreak opens Bridge_Door_Bunker.

scenarios.name: Rainbow lasers (drill)
scenarios.summary: The colour-cycling lasers, no boss HP
scenarios.description: Rainbow_LaserTimer alone (0.9-1.3 s): each wave is an s_laser_N template, a func_movelinear sweeping 3000 units down the corridor at 1250 u/s with its trigger_hurt (5000) on a func_door that bobs it up and down.

scenarios.name: Sephiroth's laser waves (drill)
scenarios.summary: Flat and tilted lasers: jump or duck
scenarios.description: Sephiroth_Laser_Timer (0.8-1.3 s), the normal ending's waves: Sephiroth_Final_Laser_Case moves Sephiroth_Final_Laser_Maker to a height and roll (flat at -92 / -116 / -117, tilted 9 and 22.1 degrees) with AddOutput origin / angles, then spawns Sephiroth_Final_Laser_Template there: a 4000-unit sweep at 1300 u/s.

scenarios.name: Cosmo ending (full)
scenarios.summary: Bahamut, Genesis, then catch the airship
scenarios.description: Insane II (Cosmo version) from 'Cosmo once 6' (its touch replayed, fastForward 44 s; Cosmo_template, spawned as the mode starts, holds Genesis, his wall and the airship). At 45 s Final_Fulgor_Relay starts Bahamut's Fulgor: Cosmo_Final_Fulgor_Breakable gets 450 HP per human from Sephiroth_Final_HP_Counter. Its OnBreak gives Genesis 260 HP (+120 per human), starts CosmoG_LaserTimer 3.2 s later (1.2-1.5 s: one of four Genesis_Laser templates, 2000 units north to south at 1380 u/s; each laser that hurts a human takes 40 HP off Genesis) and sends Rage_End_Airship off 23 s later whatever happens. Genesis' death kills Genesis_Wall and starts the airship 4 s later. Cosmo_win_once on the deck enables 'Nuke win' 1.1 s after you touch it (the airship's Path_8 does at 5 s): win by being on board when it goes off. Bahamut's Fulgor (Final_Fulgor_Hurt on Final_Fulgor_Door) swings down the junction's middle strip 10 s after the relay: stand clear of it or break him first.

scenarios.name: Genesis (final boss)
scenarios.summary: Shoot Genesis through his red lasers
scenarios.description: From the moment Bahamut falls in the Cosmo ending: the stage spawns Cosmo_template and breaks Cosmo_Final_Fulgor_Breakable, whose OnBreak sets Genesis_Final_Breakable to 260 HP and enables CosmoG_LaserTimer 3.2 s later (1.2-1.5 s refire, point_tesla sparks, blade_out). CosmoG_LaserCase picks Genesis_Laser_Temp (z -77..-57 over the walkway floor at -100: a full jump), 2Genesis / 3Genesis (low: jump) or 7Genesis (a blade spinning about the walkway on a func_rotating, 265 deg/s: duck off its centre): func_movelinear 2000 units north to south at 1380 u/s. Sephiroth_Final_HP_Counter's touch adds 120 HP per human; each laser that hurts a human takes 40 off Genesis. Win when his OnBreak disables the timer.

scenarios.name: Genesis' lasers (drill)
scenarios.summary: Jump the red lasers, duck the spinning blade
scenarios.description: CosmoG_LaserTimer alone (1.2-1.5 s): CosmoG_LaserCase spawns one of Genesis_Laser_Temp (z -77..-57 over the walkway floor at -100: a full jump), 2Genesis_Laser_Temp / 3Genesis_Laser_Temp (low: jump) or 7Genesis_Laser_Temp (a blade spinning about the walkway on a func_rotating, 265 deg/s: duck away from its centre), each a func_movelinear sweeping 2000 units down the walkway at 1380 u/s with its trigger_hurt (5000), killed 3.5 s after it spawns.
